initial_messages.content: Repair events.latest(events): each event has id, timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone, including Z) and payload. Return the latest event per id ordered by id. Compare absolute instants across offsets; on equal instants keep the last input event. Reject timestamps without timezone. Do not mutate input.

initial_files.README.txt: latest is exported by solution.py. timestamps.py parses timestamps. IDs are strings.
